SE.camera: true isometric from the SE corner (35.26 deg elevation, yaw 45 deg off the axes)

NE.camera: true isometric from the NE corner (35.26 deg elevation, yaw 45 deg off the axes)

NW.camera: true isometric from the NW corner (35.26 deg elevation, yaw 45 deg off the axes)

SW.camera: true isometric from the SW corner (35.26 deg elevation, yaw 45 deg off the axes)

elev-S.camera: straight-on elevation of the S side; darker = farther back, hot pink = open air (around the building, under a porch, under a floating block), yellow = you see into a room (a hole in the wall)

elev-E.camera: straight-on elevation of the E side; darker = farther back, hot pink = open air (around the building, under a porch, under a floating block), yellow = you see into a room (a hole in the wall)

elev-N.camera: straight-on elevation of the N side; darker = farther back, hot pink = open air (around the building, under a porch, under a floating block), yellow = you see into a room (a hole in the wall)

elev-W.camera: straight-on elevation of the W side; darker = farther back, hot pink = open air (around the building, under a porch, under a floating block), yellow = you see into a room (a hole in the wall)

interior-living.camera: SE isometric plan cut: the room box +1 block, cut 2 blocks above its floor so furniture and openings show

interior-bedroom.camera: SE isometric plan cut: the room box +1 block, cut 2 blocks above its floor so furniture and openings show
